items.fromString:
As a registered customer completing my application,
I want to view and interact with the Instruction section, access picture requirements and compliance information, and navigate easily,
So that I can understand the required steps, review applicable requirements, and proceed confidently to complete the application process.

 

Acceptance Criteria

* Screen Layout
** Haeder and Footer" should be consistent on the community theme covered in story [https://theksquaregroupglobal.atlassian.net/browse/BDBP1-94|https://theksquaregroupglobal.atlassian.net/browse/BDBP1-94|smart-link]  and [https://theksquaregroupglobal.atlassian.net/browse/BDBP1-96|https://theksquaregroupglobal.atlassian.net/browse/BDBP1-96|smart-link]
** Left Side component is consistent on the community theme covered by Jira Ticket [https://theksquaregroupglobal.atlassian.net/browse/BDBP1-95|https://theksquaregroupglobal.atlassian.net/browse/BDBP1-95|smart-link] 
* Instruction Section Content
** Displays guidelines for completing the application, including:
*** Requirement to take/upload a picture.
*** Application completion instructions.
*** Compliance notice for U.S. citizens/residents regarding FATCA.
* Hyperlinks and Buttons
** See Picture Requirements hyperlink opens in a new tab and displays picture guidelines.
** Three buttons displayed at the bottom of the section:
*** See Requirements for National Individuals → Opens link in a new tab:
[[https://www.bankofsaintlucia.com/services/customer-types/view/1/59#:~:text=For%20individuals%2018%20years%20&%20older,be%20included%20on%20an%20account.]|https://www.bankofsaintlucia.com/services/customer-types/view/1/59#:~:text=For%20individuals%2018%20years%20&%20older,be%20included%20on%20an%20account.]]
*** See Requirements for International Individuals → Opens link in a new tab:
[[https://www.bankofsaintlucia.com/services/customer-types/view/2/65|https://www.bankofsaintlucia.com/services/customer-types/view/2/65]]
*** See Requirements for Self-Employed Individuals → Opens link in a new tab:
[[https://www.bankofsaintlucia.com/services/customer-types/view/6/64|https://www.bankofsaintlucia.com/services/customer-types/view/6/64]]
** FATCA link under Important Compliance Notice opens in a new tab to the FATCA form page.
* Navigation
** Continue button navigates to the next section: Personal Information.
** Save Progress button saves data and displays confirmation message:
_“Your progress has been saved.”_
** Back to Dashboard button navigates to dashboard with warning if unsaved changes exist.
* Design Compliance
** BOSL branding (colors, fonts, logo) applied consistently.
** Responsive design verified across desktop and mobile.
* 

*Significance*

This section ensures customers understand application requirements and compliance obligations before proceeding. It improves transparency, reduces errors, and supports regulatory compliance while maintaining a consistent user experience.

*Definition of Done*

* Instruction section implemented per Figma design.
* All hyperlinks and buttons open in a new tab and point to correct URLs.
* FATCA link displayed under compliance notice and opens correctly.
* Navigation buttons (Continue, Save Progress, Back to Dashboard) function as expected.
* QA validates responsiveness and usability across devices.
* Smoke tests pass successfully in staging environment.
* UAT sign-off obtained from BOSL team.

*Dependencies*

* BOSL branding guidelines and reusable header/footer components.
* Verified URLs for picture requirements, FATCA, and applicant requirement pages.
* Backend readiness for saving progress and navigation logic.

*Risks*

* Incorrect or broken links may prevent users from accessing compliance information.
* Navigation issues may block progress to the next section.
* Branding inconsistencies may reduce trust and user confidence.
